scripts.dev: npm run sync:env && concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @abroadly/frontend" "npm run dev -w @abroadly/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @abroadly/backend && npm run build -w @abroadly/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run start -w @abroadly/frontend" "npm run start -w @abroadly/backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @abroadly/frontend && npm run lint -w @abroadly/backend
scripts.seed:all: npm run seed:content && npm run seed:test
